CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 (Class A ordinary shares, CUSIP G4124C109); Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities. The CalPERS percentage divides its Class A shares by Class A plus Class B outstanding at September 30, 2026 from the Q3 2026 results release (warrants excluded), the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: null; the FY2025 20-F gives only U.S. record holders (15 for Class A and three for Class B as of January 31, 2026), not a total.
